gamerule.netherworldAfterDeath: The dead go to the Netherworld
gamerule.netherworldAfterDeath.descripti: Players who die wake at the Ghost Gate as ghosts, and return to life at the Wheel of Reincarnation.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.ghost_c: The third foundation, the Ghost Kings' own: gather the yin into a core of cold fire. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Core Formation, where the dead are kings.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 21: Ghost Core Burst. Layer 25: King's Decree. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.ghost_f: Cold fire drawn out of yin, that burns the dead worst of all. A ghost's blows strike harder.

Your ghost path opens its layers: 1-3 at Qi Refining, 4-6 at Foundation Building, 7-9 at Core Formation. Layer 1: Ghost Fire. Layer 4: Ghost Fire Bolt. Layer 7: the fire leaps to a second foe. Every layer: a ghost's blows +10%.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.netherw: The first foundation of the ghost cultivators: breathe the Netherworld's yin and keep it. It carries your ghost path through Qi Refining, with a deeper ghost qi pool, a ghost's hearts, and longer among the dead for the living.
Qi Refining: layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 3: Ghost Eye. Layer 5: Ghostly Wail. Layer 6: Netherworld Veil. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.nine_ne: The fourth foundation, out of the depths of the Nine Nethers: a soul born again of yin. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Nascent Soul.
Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 30: Soul Rend. Layer 34: Nine Nether Step. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.six_pat: The last foundation, the law of the Wheel itself: the six paths of rebirth turn within you. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining all the way through Four Axis.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 48: Wheel of Samsara. Layer 52: Six Paths Annihilation. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.wanderi: How the dead drift where the wind goes. A ghost moves swifter.

Your ghost path opens its layers: 1-3 at Qi Refining, 4-6 at Foundation Building, 7-9 at Core Formation. Layer 1: Yin Wind Steps. Layer 2: Soul Dash. Layers 4-9: the free flight of the dead and of a Ghost King's form +10% swifter each (+60% at 9). Every layer: a ghost +3% speed.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.yama_ju: The fifth foundation, the Judges' own: weigh souls as the courts of the underworld weigh them. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Heavenly Being.
Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 39: Yama's Verdict. Layer 43: Chains of Hell. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
ghost_method.defying-the-heavens.yellow_: The second foundation: steep the bones in the Yellow Springs' waters until the marrow runs with yin. It carries your ghost path from Qi Refining through Foundation Building.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers each: of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection. Layer 12: Yellow Springs Tide. Layer 16: Marrow Ward. Every layer: +20 ghost qi.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.ancien: Carved into the bark of a cypress that outlived three dynasties, this art teaches the cultivator to grow ring upon ring and endure every storm, and to scatter thorns among its roots for whatever comes to fell it.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Thousand Leaf Storm (layer 21), Ancient Bark Skin (layer 25). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.boundl: The canon of the waters that ring the world at its four axes, from which every river comes and to which every river returns. At its end lies the abyss of the north, where even time stands frozen.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Absolute Zero (layer 48), Boundless Sea (layer 52). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.clear_: Written beside a fount that never froze and never failed. It teaches qi to rise from deep in the body as spring water rises from the rock, washing every impurity away as it climbs.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Rain Call (layer 11), Water Prison (layer 14), Torrential Spring (layer 17). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.coilin: A recluse left it in a ruined mountain shrine after watching wild vines pull the shrine's walls down over forty springs. It teaches qi to climb, to coil and never to let go.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Life Force Drain (layer 11), Life Force Gain (layer 14), Mysterious Bristle Prison (layer 17). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.crimso: Written by an alchemist who held that a golden core is only ore until it is smelted. The body becomes a crucible, and the core is poured from fire refined nine times over, until it blooms like a lotus in the flame.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Crimson Swirl (layer 21), Solar Field (layer 25). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.ember_: A hearth-keeper's method handed down in mountain villages. Breath is banked in the dantian like coals under ash at night and fanned again at dawn, so that even the smallest ember of qi never goes out.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Flame Bolt (layer 2), Flame Fist (layer 5), Crimson Tempering (layer 8). Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.eterna: Recited in the peach gardens of the immortals, where spring never yields to autumn. Here life renews itself without pause and mends the wounds of all it shelters, and what it cannot grow it takes, as the strangler fig takes its host.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Heaven-Piercing Bamboo (layer 39), Spring of Myriad Life (layer 43). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.five_s: The five sacred mountains stand at the four quarters and the centre of the land. This classic teaches the cultivator to gather their weight into a single core that nothing under heaven can shift.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Earth Dragon Surge (layer 21), Mountain Stance (layer 25). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.four_p: When Mount Buzhou broke and the sky tilted, four pillars were raised at the ends of the world to hold heaven up again. This scripture is found only above the clouds, and is said to be cut into the stone of those pillars themselves.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Earthen Titan (layer 48), Mountain Seal (layer 52). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.four_s: The Metal at the four axes of the world, forged into four swords that stand at the gates of creation. Whoever enters their array is never let out, and whoever wears this Canon's golden body is broken by no single blow.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Heaven-Severing Sword (layer 48), Four Swords Array (layer 52). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.furnac: The foundation is laid as the floor of a furnace beneath the heart. Breath works the bellows, each layer tempers the furnace walls, and whatever is thrown into its fire is refined, not lost.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Remote Yang Bomb (layer 11), Flame Armour (layer 14), Fire Serpent (layer 17). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.golden: Said to be copied from the marks the three-legged golden crow left on the great mulberry of the eastern sea before it carried the sun across the sky. Its practitioners learn to bear a sun within them, as bright as noon.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Phoenix Descent (layer 39), Sea of Flames (layer 43). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.

Left in a cave beneath the Thunder Peaks by a sword cultivator who let heaven's lightning hammer his core like an anvil until it rang gold. Its practitioners point and armour splits; they open their hand and the thunder leaps.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Sword Rain (layer 21), Golden Bell Shield (layer 25). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.green_: Village hermits copied this primer from the margins of an old almanac. It teaches you to breathe the way a seed breathes when it splits its husk, drawing green qi up from the soil through the soles of the feet; humble and patient, it is the root every Wood art grows from.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Wood Bullet (layer 2), Emerald Healing Art (layer 5), Verdant Growth (layer 8). Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.heaven: The root-script of the tree that stood where the four axes meet before heaven and earth were parted, bearing the sky upon its branches. Whoever completes it carries a world within their trunk, and all beneath its shade are kept.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Myriad Vine Binding (layer 48), World Tree (layer 52). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.

The highest fire under the four axes of heaven, the fire of the phoenix that burns itself to ash and rises again. Its masters set storms of flame loose across the sky and, once in a long while, refuse death itself.

Qi Refining to Four Axis, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Nine Suns Descend (layer 48), Phoenix Nirvana (layer 52). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.

Recovered from the deepest grave of the Ancient Sword Graveyard, a scripture of the edge that cuts even karma, severing whatever heaven has granted. At its height the practitioner calls down the swords of every master buried there.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Mountain Cleave (layer 39), Sword Domain (layer 43). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
Said to be copied from the starry river that divides the sky. It teaches qi to fall from the heavens with the whole weight of the celestial current behind it, and to drown whatever it closes over.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Heavenly River Torrent (layer 39), Frozen Field (layer 43). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.hundre: The foundation is folded a hundred times like sword steel and laid about a lodestone heart. Iron leans toward its practitioner, and the weapons of others grow heavy in their hands.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Boulder Cleave (layer 11), Mineral Purification (layer 14), Advanced Flying Sword Technique (layer 17). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.moon_m: Composed by a recluse who sat for a hundred years beside a lake so still that it held the moon twice. The sutra teaches the heart to become still water, reflecting all things and holding none.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Glacial Spears (layer 30), Great Tide (layer 34). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.mornin: A humble breathing art of river hermits. You sit among wet grass before sunrise and draw in the cold qi that settles with the dew, until your meridians run as clear as a mountain brook.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Water Arrow (layer 2), Azure Coating Technique (layer 5), Azure Breathing Technique (layer 8). Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.nine_b: The nascent soul is cast like a great bell with nine swords hung inside it. When it tolls, every blade answers, and all who hear it share one another's wounds.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Piercing Sword Light (layer 30), Vajra Body (layer 34). It teaches the metal spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Whetted Edge.
A record of the great river that turns nine times on its way to the sea, never contending with the mountains yet wearing them all away. From it the cultivator learns to bend, to coil and to carry.

Qi Refining to Core Formation, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Tidal Lance (layer 21), Mist Veil (layer 25). It teaches the water spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Ceaseless Flow.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.primev: The canon of a forest sect whose elders sat beneath the trees so long that none could say where their meridians ended and the roots began. Its cultivator becomes a whole wood, drowsy with blossom and bristling with thorns.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Thorn Spear Forest (layer 30), Lotus of Rebirth (layer 34). It teaches the wood spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Evergreen Vitality.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.rammed: A village builder's manual, its pages stiff with dried clay. It teaches the body to take in the soil's qi one layer at a time, packed hard, the way earth is rammed between boards to raise a wall.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Earth Spear (layer 2), Hardened Body (layer 5), Dirt Tide (layer 8). Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.sovere: Sovereign Earth carries every mountain, river and living thing and never once complains of the weight. Those who recite this sutra learn to bear what others cannot, and to become the ground beneath their companions' feet.

Qi Refining to Heavenly Being, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Falling Mountain (layer 39), Heavy Earth Seal (layer 43). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.thousa: Copied from a cliff face by a hermit who read the strata like the pages of a book. It records stone laid on stone over ten thousand years, each layer pressing the one beneath into something harder.

Qi Refining to Foundation Building, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Earth Wall Technique (layer 11), Boulder Throw (layer 14), Cave Formation (layer 17). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.vermil: The Nascent Soul is hatched in the fire of the south and takes the shape of the Vermilion Bird, guardian of the summer quarter of the sky. Its talons sear what they touch, and its descent sets the plains alight.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Karmic Fire (layer 30), Blazing Meteor (layer 34). It teaches the fire spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Fury of the Fanned Flame.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.whetst: A smith's apprentice's manual, its pages black with forge soot: grind your qi as a whetstone grinds iron and hang it about the body like an iron bell, until one thread of it grows keen enough to fly out and come home.

Qi Refining, nine layers (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Flying Sword (layer 2), Blade Polish (layer 5), Steel Hurricane (layer 8). Every layer: Whetted Edge.
heaven_method.defying-the-heavens.yellow: Beneath every mountain run the earth's veins, and in them sleeps the Yellow Dragon of the Centre. This canon teaches the nascent soul to swim those veins beside it, and to wake it.

Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, nine layers a realm (of each realm's nine, layer 1 Early, 3 Mid, 6 Late, 9 Grand Perfection; each opens when your cultivation reaches it). Its realm's spells: Summon Golem (layer 30), Earthquake (layer 34). It teaches the earth spells of every realm below it too. Every layer: Unshaken Mountain Body.
item.defying-the-heavens.cultivation_fru: Eat for up to %s unrefined qi
physique.defying-the-heavens.blessed_mer: Wide, clean meridians: qi gathers 1.5 times as fast into a pool 1.5 times as deep, and Qi Sense opens from a mortal's first day.
physique.defying-the-heavens.cursed_meri: Meridians that leak: qi gathers 0.8 times as fast into a pool 0.8 times as deep.
physique.defying-the-heavens.fallen_true: An immortal reborn in a mortal body: any element, five times the pace on both paths, and a method's new layers need no settling.
physique.defying-the-heavens.five_elemen: Roots of all five elements: any element's methods may be learned, at the ordinary pace.
physique.defying-the-heavens.ghost_devil: Half the dead's already: the ghost path at twice the pace, and a Ghost King's form of its own anywhere, even among the living, as strong as its ghost methods allow. Find a ghost method of a deeper realm and the ghost path leaps to it.
physique.defying-the-heavens.heaven_sacr: The heavens favour it: no Ritual to the Heavens is wanted at Qi Refining Mid, and heaven methods are cultivated 1.2 times as fast.
physique.defying-the-heavens.heavenly_th: The rarest of all. A tribulation's lightning feeds it instead of harming it: every bolt taken becomes cultivation and qi.
physique.defying-the-heavens.innate_alch: Pills and elixirs brewed by its hands work twice as strongly.
physique.defying-the-heavens.innate_cons: A Consciousness Domain as wide as a Four Axis cultivator's the day it opens. It never grows past that.
physique.defying-the-heavens.jade_poison: No medicinal toxicity ever builds up, and the qi of pills and spirit fruit is refined the moment it is taken.
physique.defying-the-heavens.mortal_body: An ordinary body. Nothing helps it and nothing holds it back.
physique.defying-the-heavens.shattered_m: Meridians that will never hold qi: no cultivation, no heaven methods, no spells. The body can be tempered on past a mortal's Peak instead, eight stages of body refining, the last as strong as a Core Formation cultivator's. Meditation tempers it too.
physique.defying-the-heavens.three_eleme: Roots of three elements only: methods of those three alone, cultivated 1.5 times as fast.
physique.defying-the-heavens.true_elemen: A single pure root: one element's methods alone, cultivated twice as fast.
physique.defying-the-heavens.yin_soul_bo: A soul at home in yin: yin corruption never takes hold of it.
A beam of utter cold freezes the being you look at solid, within 48 blocks: 200 water harm, and it is held frozen for 5 s. When anything strikes it, or the cold lets go, it shatters for 60 more.
spell.defying-the-heavens.advanced_flyin: Six swords form in the air round you one after another, then fly one after another at where you look: 9 metal harm each, each passing through one being to strike another.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ancient_bark_s: For 20 s ancient bark grows over you: 20% less harm taken, 40% less of earth's. A wood ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.azure_breathin: For 60 s you can walk and run on water (sneak to sink into it) and breathe under it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.azure_coating_: For 30 s a thin coat of water clings to you: fire cannot burn you and fire spells stop at it (a fire spell of a deeper realm than this still breaks half through). Lava boils it away. A water ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.blade_polish.d: For 30 s every melee blow you strike deals 1.2 times its harm, and the weapon in your hand gives off a faint white glow and wisps of white smoke.
spell.defying-the-heavens.blazing_meteor: Calls a burning meteor down out of the sky onto where you look, up to 48 blocks, its mark glowing on the ground as it falls: 45 fire harm to everything within 6 blocks, burning for 6 s, and a crater 6 blocks round blown out of the ground (or whatever is built there), its floor burnt to magma and blackstone, fires round it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.boulder_cleave: Flings a crescent of sword qi from you the way you look. It flies 15 blocks through the ground as through air, cutting a slot 3 blocks wide and 2 tall through everything it passes (what it cuts is gone), and cleaves every being in its way for 14 metal harm.
Tears a boulder out of the ground ahead of you, leaving a round hole two blocks deep, gathers it in the air and throws it at where you aim, up to 48 blocks: 16 earth harm and a heavy knock back. It tears it from whatever lies ahead, ground or what is built there (not inside a barrier).
A sphere of the sea 16 blocks round fills the place you look at, up to 48 blocks, for 8 s: every foe inside is held in it, drowning, and takes 22 water harm a second. When it lets go, the ground under it is left crushed into a basin 10 blocks round with a lake in it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.cave_formation: Carves a cave fit for one into the slope or ground you look at, within 6 blocks, crumbling it away before your eyes over 3 s: into a slope, an entrance one block wide and two tall with a room three blocks wide, deep and tall behind it; into the ground, three steps down to such a room.
A great tornado of fire rises 3 blocks ahead of you and creeps toward where you aim (up to 40 blocks away) for 10 s. It drags in and lifts whatever comes near, burns all within it for 6 fire harm a second, tears up the ground beneath it (and what is built there) and leaves fire behind.
spell.defying-the-heavens.crimson_temper: For 30 s fire and lava cannot burn you, and lava bears your weight: you can walk and run across it. A fire ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.dirt_tide.desc: Raises a wave of the earth you stand on and carries you on its crest for 10 s, the way you face, faster than a sprint: forward drives it on, back reins it in, and it climbs a block at a time and rides over water. Sneak to step off.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earth_dragon_s: A ridge of jagged spikes of the ground's own rock bursts up along the ground from you toward where you face, 24 blocks out, running out as fast as a horse: whatever it passes over takes 20 earth harm and is thrown into the air. The spikes sink back a few seconds later.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earth_spear.de: Raises clods of earth into the air before you, where they fuse into a podao of dried earth, then flings it at where you aim, up to 40 blocks: 6 earth harm and a heavy knock back.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earth_wall_tec: A wall of the ground you stand on, 6 blocks long and 4 tall, rises out of the earth 3 blocks ahead of you, across your way. If you are not on the ground, it forms in mid air, from its middle block outward. It stands for 30 s, then sinks back into the ground.
Raises an earth titan three times a golem's size beside you for 60 s: it flies, keeps by you and fights for you, 400 health and 80 earth harm a blow, its fist striking the ground round its mark too. One at a time.
spell.defying-the-heavens.earthquake.des: The ground shakes 20 blocks round you for 4 s and splits: nine fissures up to 5 blocks deep run out from near you to its edge, and every foe on the ground takes 14 earth harm a second, is slowed hard and thrown about.
spell.defying-the-heavens.emerald_healin: For 10 s you heal 1 health every second, fed or hungry, and glow a faint green.
spell.defying-the-heavens.falling_mounta: A mountain of rock forms in the sky over where you look, up to 64 blocks, and falls on it: 140 earth harm to everything within 10 blocks, a shockwave, a crater 12 blocks round and 7 deep (its floor broken rubble), and seven fissures splitting the land out to 26 blocks.
spell.defying-the-heavens.fire_serpent.d: A serpent of fire coils out of your hand and swims through the air at where you aim, bending toward its mark as it goes, up to 48 blocks: 12 fire harm and burning for 4 s.
spell.defying-the-heavens.flame_armour.d: For 30 s you are clad in armour made of red flame, from its burning crest to its greaves. It takes 10% off all harm you take, and 20% off metal's (metal spells, and blows of iron, gold, diamond or netherite weapons). A fire ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.flame_bolt.des: Shoots a bolt of red flame from your hand at where you aim, up to 40 blocks. It strikes for 5 fire harm and sets its mark burning for 3 s. Water puts it out: a being under a water ward (Azure Coating) takes none of it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.flame_fist.des: For 15 s your fists burn with red and orange flame. Every blow you land sets its mark burning for 5 s and sears it for 1 more fire harm. Against a being under a water ward the flames only hiss out.
spell.defying-the-heavens.flying_sword.d: Forms a sword of metal in the air before you, shard by shard, and shoots it at where you aim, up to 48 blocks: 6 metal harm, and it flies on through its first mark to strike another.
spell.defying-the-heavens.four_swords_ar: Four giant swords plant themselves at the corners of a square 32 blocks across round where you look, up to 48 blocks, each driven deep into the ground in a crater 4 blocks round: for 8 s every foe inside is held in by the walls of light between them and takes 80 metal harm a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.frozen_field.d: The cold runs out from you to 64 blocks round over two and a half seconds: open water freezes, frost lies on the ground within 32 blocks, and every being it reaches (but your allies and pets) is frozen solid for 3 s. The ice thaws over the next 20 to 40 s, and until it has, every being in the field takes 3 water harm a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ghost_core_bur: Your core flares: everything within 5 blocks takes 4 hearts of ghostly harm, is thrown back and set burning with ghost fire.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ghost_fire.des: Wreathe your hands in cold fire: your next 3 blows within 20 seconds set what they strike burning (3 ghost qi each). It burns the dead three times as hard.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ghost_fire_bol: Throw a bolt of ghost fire up to 24 blocks: it strikes the first being in its path and sets it burning.
spell.defying-the-heavens.ghostly_wail.d: A cry of the dead: everything within 8 blocks is driven back, slowed and weakened, and the dead are torn at.
spell.defying-the-heavens.glacial_spears: Five spears of ice form over your head and fly in a fan at where you look: 11 water harm each, slowness for 3 s and the cold's frost.
spell.defying-the-heavens.golden_bell_sh: A great golden bell comes down over you for 10 s and takes up to 40 harm for you, tolling with each blow; wood's harm costs it half as much, fire's twice. A metal ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.great_tide.des: A wave 10 blocks tall and 14 wide rolls out 30 blocks the way you face: whatever it overtakes takes 30 water harm, is swept along hard and put out.
For 30 s a thin skin of stone covers you, taking 7% off all harm you take (14% off water's). An earth ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_hell_pi: A spell of both paths. Where you look, up to 32 blocks, heaven's light falls and hell's fire rises: everything within 5 blocks takes 15 hearts of harm, is thrown up and set burning.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_piercin: Giant bamboo bursts up out of the ground under as many as 6 foes within 24 blocks of where you look, breaking the ground open: 70 wood harm each, and they are thrown high into the air.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heaven_severin: A sword of light as long as a tower forms in your hand and you swing it level across your front: a giant crescent of sword light some 110 blocks across leaves its edge and flies out level from your chest the way you face, 120 blocks, faster than anything can flee it: nothing stops it. It cuts through whatever its blade passes through, 10 blocks thick at its middle and thinner toward its tips: hills and mountains are sliced through (their tops left standing above the cut), trees felled, whatever is built in its way cut in two, and the land at its far end is cut in the crescent's curve. Every being its blade passes through takes 300 metal harm and is hurled ahead of it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heavenly_river: A river pours out of the sky along a line from you to where you look, 32 blocks, for 2 s: everyone in its fall takes 60 water harm and is swept along it, and the river scours a channel 3 blocks across into the ground along its line.
spell.defying-the-heavens.heavy_earth_se: Every foe within 24 blocks of you is pressed to the ground for 6 s: it cannot jump or fly (a flier is brought down), is slowed hard, and takes 20 earth harm a second. Under its weight the land 24 blocks round you sinks by up to 2 blocks, cracked and split by ten fissures (all but where you stand).
spell.defying-the-heavens.hell_chains.de: Chains drag every foe within 12 blocks to you and hold them fast for 3 seconds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.karmic_fire.de: Sets karmic fire on the being you look at, within 32 blocks, for 8 s, burning away its sins: each second it takes 1 harm if it is guiltless, up to 11 for a devil (by its alignment), 6 for a monster, a little for a beast or a villager. A sinner's alignment burns 2 a second toward neutral.
spell.defying-the-heavens.kings_decree.d: A Ghost King's word: every foe within 16 blocks is weakened, slowed and shown glowing for 8 seconds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.life_death_sea: A spell of both paths. Seal the being you look at, up to 32 blocks: for 8 seconds it loses 2 hearts a second, living or dead, and half of it comes to you. It is slowed while sealed.
spell.defying-the-heavens.life_force_dra: For 6 s you draw the life out of the being you look at or a herb growing there (a ginseng), within 12 blocks, or the years out of a single Cultivation Fruit or herb you hold (a fruit on its tree can't be drawn on). A being loses 1.5 health a second, and it heals you; a herb or fruit loses 60 years a second, and you heal 1 a second. A stream of emerald light runs from it to you. It breaks if you stray 16 blocks apart. Herbs in a sect's or a Ghost King's treasury can't be touched while its seal holds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.life_force_gai: For 6 s you pour your own life into the being you look at, or into an aging herb or fruit growing within 12 blocks, or a single one you hold: you lose 1 health a second (never below 4), and a being heals 2 a second, or a herb gains 120 years a second. Herbs in a sealed treasury can't be touched.
spell.defying-the-heavens.lotus_of_rebir: A great lotus opens at your feet for 10 s: you and every friendly being within 10 blocks are cleansed of harmful effects and fire at once, and heal 3 health a second while it blooms.
spell.defying-the-heavens.marrow_ward.de: Your bones hold like iron for 10 seconds: Resistance II and 4 hearts of absorption.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mineral_purifi: Every ore within the reach of your consciousness (your Consciousness Domain's radius) gives up its ore: it streams to you as light and is yours, as mined and unsmelted, the rock it lay in left behind. At most 256 ores, the nearest first. Ores inside a raised barrier (protective or concealment) are beyond its reach.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mist_veil.desc: A thick mist rises 10 blocks round you for 15 s, moving with you: foes in it lose sight of you and your allies (unless within 3 blocks of them), and missiles flying into it slow to half their speed.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mountain_cleav: Flings a crescent of sword qi as tall as a tower the way you look. It flies 140 blocks, cutting a slot 4 blocks wide and 16 tall through hills and mountains alike (what it cuts is gone), and cleaves every being in its way for 150 metal harm.
A mountain of stone bursts up over where you look, up to 48 blocks, 7 blocks round and 9 tall, tearing the land open round its foot in nine fissures out to 18 blocks: everything inside is entombed, held fast for 5 s and crushed for 60 earth harm a second. The mountain crumbles away after 20 s; its stone gives nothing.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mountain_stanc: For 15 s you stand like a mountain, clad in slabs of stone: 25% less harm taken (50% less of water's), and nothing can knock you back, but you walk a fifth slower. An earth ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.myriad_vine_bi: Vines burst up and seize as many as 12 foes within 40 blocks of where you look, up to 64 blocks: each is held fast for 5 s and takes 22 wood harm a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.mysterious_bri: Thorny bristles burst up out of the ground round the being you look at, within 20 blocks, and close over it: it is held where it stands for 4 s, torn for 1.5 wood harm a second. Three blows on the cage break it, from outside or in; but each one the prisoner strikes from inside tears it for 2 more.
spell.defying-the-heavens.nine_nether_st: Step through the dark to where you look, up to 24 blocks, short of any wall. Falls do you no harm for a moment after.
spell.defying-the-heavens.nine_suns_desc: Nine suns fall out of the sky, one after another, onto where you look and round it, up to 64 blocks: each bursts for 150 fire harm 7 blocks round, burning for 6 s, and blows a scorched crater 6 blocks round out of the ground: together they leave the land a burning field of craters 16 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.phoenix_descen: A phoenix of fire takes wing from you and flies at where you aim, bending toward its mark, up to 64 blocks, and bursts there: 90 fire harm to everything within 5 blocks, burning for 6 s, and a scorched crater 4 blocks round.
spell.defying-the-heavens.phoenix_nirvan: For 60 s the phoenix's fire waits in you: if you would die, you rise again instead at full health, harmful effects burnt away, in a burst of flame that strikes everyone but your allies within 10 blocks for 200 fire harm. Once.
spell.defying-the-heavens.piercing_sword: A beam of sword light pierces everything along your look for 64 blocks, walls and hills too: it bores a tunnel 3 blocks across through whatever stands in its way, and every being along it takes 55 metal harm.
spell.defying-the-heavens.primordial_cha: A spell of both paths, made one again. Everything within 16 blocks is dragged in and takes 25 hearts of harm; a tenth of all of it mends you, and you have Strength II for 10 seconds.
spell.defying-the-heavens.rain_call.desc: Calls a rain cloud of your own over where you stand, 8 blocks round, for 20 s. Everyone under it but you is slowed by a tenth, and the rain puts out fires and whatever burns.
spell.defying-the-heavens.remote_yang_bo: Leaves a ball of yang fire on the surface you look at, within 16 blocks. Only you, and those with Qi Sense open, can see it. While it waits it draws 1 qi a second from you. Cast the spell again within 48 blocks to set it off: 14 fire harm to everything within 4 blocks, burning for 4 s, and a blast that throws them back. Setting it off costs nothing; the spell then rests for 15 s. It gutters out if your qi runs dry or you go far from it.
The six paths turn: your health is made whole, your harmful effects are gone, and half your yin corruption with them.
The ground 20 blocks round where you look, up to 48 blocks, becomes a sea of flame for 10 s: the land itself burns (grass scorched, patches turned to magma and netherrack, fires on whatever stands there, trees catching), and every foe standing in it takes 20 fire harm a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.six_paths_anni: Six pillars of cold fire rise round you: everything within 12 blocks takes 20 hearts of ghostly harm and is hurled away.
spell.defying-the-heavens.solar_field.de: A small sun burns 8 blocks above you for 10 s. Everyone else within 40 blocks of you is set burning, every second, as if standing in fire (a water ward or a fire-proof body excepted).
spell.defying-the-heavens.soul_dash.desc: Rush forward on the yin wind, about eight blocks. Falls do you no harm for a moment after.
spell.defying-the-heavens.soul_rend.desc: A beam of the Nine Nethers' dark, 32 blocks: every being in its line takes 8 hearts of ghostly harm.
spell.defying-the-heavens.spring_of_myri: A green rain of life falls 32 blocks round you for 10 s: you and every friendly being in it heal 40 health at once, then 4 a second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.steel_hurrican: You dash the way you look with your weapon thrust before you, spinning like a trident's riptide, for 1.6 s: every being you meet takes your weapon's blow and 3 metal harm more. No fall harm from it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.summon_golem.d: Raises an earth golem out of the ground beside you for 90 s. It flies (at three fifths of a cultivator's flight), keeps by you and fights for you: whatever strikes you or you strike, or a monster that comes for you. 80 health, 18 earth harm a blow. Two at most: a third sends the oldest back to the earth.
spell.defying-the-heavens.sword_domain.d: Thirty-six swords circle you 10 blocks round for 12 s: every foe within takes 20 metal harm every half second.
spell.defying-the-heavens.sword_rain.des: Twelve swords form in a ring high over where you look, up to 32 blocks, and plunge down round it: 6 metal harm each.
spell.defying-the-heavens.taiji_shield.d: A spell of both paths. Light and dark turn round you for 10 seconds: arrows and fireballs shot at you are turned back on whoever shot them, and you have Resistance I.
spell.defying-the-heavens.thorn_spear_fo: Spears of thorny wood burst out of the ground 6 blocks round where you look, up to 32 blocks: every foe there takes 35 wood harm and is held where it stands for 2 s.
spell.defying-the-heavens.thousand_leaf_: Sixteen razor leaves stream from your palm over a second, each bending a little toward a foe: 2.5 wood harm each, every one its own cut. Against a fire ward they burn to ash.
spell.defying-the-heavens.tidal_lance.de: A jet of water bursts from your hands for 2 s, as far as 24 blocks: the first being in it takes 6 water harm every half second and is driven back along it.
spell.defying-the-heavens.torrential_spr: Gathers a great ball of water out of the air above and ahead of you over 1.5 s, then drops it on where you look, up to 32 blocks: 8 water harm to everything within 4 blocks, a heavy wash that throws them back, and a small lake pressed into the ground where it falls.
spell.defying-the-heavens.vajra_body.des: For 12 s your skin turns to gold: 35% less harm taken (70% less of wood's), nothing can knock you back, and whoever strikes you in melee takes 4 metal harm. A metal ward.
spell.defying-the-heavens.verdant_growth: A tree grows up out of the ground under your feet in two seconds, lifting you 14 blocks into the air on its trunk, and spreads a blossoming crown round you at the top. It stands for 60 s, then withers away; its wood and leaves give nothing when broken. Cast it standing on the ground.
spell.defying-the-heavens.water_arrow.de: Forms an arrow of swirling water in the air and shoots it at where you aim, up to 40 blocks: 5 water harm, and whatever burns on its mark is put out. Strong against fire wards.
spell.defying-the-heavens.water_prison.d: Encases the being you look at, within 16 blocks, in a sphere of water for 4 s. The air is drawn out of it at once: it drowns from the first second (no held breath), takes 2 water harm a second besides, and is held where it is. 30 harm struck on the sphere bursts it, the prisoner's own blows from inside too.
spell.defying-the-heavens.wood_bullet.de: Grows a sharp wooden stake in the air before you, then shoots it at where you aim, up to 40 blocks: 5 wood harm and a small knock back. Against a fire ward (Crimson Tempering, Flame Armour) the stake burns to ash.
spell.defying-the-heavens.world_tree.des: The World Tree grows out of the ground where you look (or before you), its roots heaving the land open in eight fissures, and towers over all for 12 s. Its vines reach from its boughs for every being but you within 32 blocks of its trunk (your pets spared), lift them into its branches and hold them there, drinking 10 of their health a second into you.
spell.defying-the-heavens.yama_verdict.d: Judge the being you look at, up to 32 blocks: 10 hearts of ghostly harm, twice that if it is below half its health.
spell.defying-the-heavens.yellow_springs: A surge of the Yellow Springs' water rushes 7 blocks ahead: all it reaches is driven back and slowed, and the dead take 3 hearts.
A spell of both paths. A palm of light and shadow strikes the first being within 16 blocks: 5 hearts of harm, living or dead, and it is thrown back. A quarter of the harm mends you.
